description: Use this when someone asks for the characters they made themselves on AI Anyone: "show my characters", "open the character I made", "talk to my AI Anyone character". Needs the person's AI Anyone account: the first time, they are asked to sign in to AI Anyone, and only their own characters come back. Returns a grid of their characters, each one ready to open on AI Anyone.

page.description: Which page of 24, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
